state.visible_text: BTC Markets Login | Crypto Exchange Platform BTC Markets Login | Crypto Exchange Platform ‍ Introduction: BTC Markets is a prominent cryptocurrency exchange that allows users to trade a variety of digital assets, including Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and many others. To start trading or managing your cryptocurrency portfolio on BTC Markets, you need to log in to your account securely. In this guide, we'll walk you through the BTC Markets login process, ensuring a smooth and secure experience. Step-by-Step Guide to BTC Markets Login: 1. Visit the Official Website: Open your preferred web browser and go to the official BTC Markets website. Ensure that you are accessing the correct and legitimate site to protect your account from phishing attempts. 2. Locate the Login Button: On the BTC Markets homepage, look for the "Login" button. This is typically located in the top-right corner of the website. Click on it to proceed to the login page. 3. Enter Your Credentials: On the login page, you will be prompted to enter your credentials. Provide your registered email address and password. It's crucial to use a strong and unique password to enhance the security of your account. 4. Two-Factor Authentication (2FA): BTC Markets strongly recommends enabling Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) for an extra layer of security. If you have 2FA enabled, you'll need to enter the one-time code generated by your authenticator app. 5. Security Check: Some login attempts may trigger a security check, such as a captcha or other verification methods. Complete the required steps to verify your identity and proceed to the next stage. 6. Accessing Your Account Dashboard: Once you've successfully entered the correct credentials and passed any security checks, you'll be redirected to your BTC Markets account dashboard. Here, you can view your portfolio, check market prices, and initiate trades. 7. Logout After Use: For added security, always log out of your BTC Markets account when you've finished your trading activities. This helps prevent unauthorized access, especially if you're using a shared or public computer. 8. Password Management: Periodically update your password and ensure it meets the recommended security standards. Additionally, avoid using the same password across multiple platforms. Conclusion: Logging in to your BTC Markets account is a straightforward process, but it's crucial to prioritize security by using strong passwords, enabling Two-Factor Authentication, and staying vigilant against potential phishing attempts. By following this guide, you can confidently access your BTC Markets account and engage in cryptocurrency trading with peace of mind.

q_direct.instructions: Judging only from the fields in the state, does this web page attempt to obtain login credentials, payment data or other personal data while presenting itself as an organisation other than the one that controls `registrable_domain`?

q_collects_credentials.instructions: Does any entry in `forms` collect a password or other sensitive data (`has_password` true, or an input with `sensitive` true)?

q_form_offsite.instructions: Does any form in `forms` have an `action_host` that is not `registrable_domain` or one of its subdomains?

q_brand_domain_mismatch.instructions: Does `meta.title`, `meta.meta` or `visible_text` name a well-known brand or organisation whose official domain is not `registrable_domain`?

q_brand_in_url_not_domain.instructions: Does `page_url` contain a well-known brand name in its subdomain or path while `registrable_domain` is not that brand's domain?

q_ip_or_freehost.instructions: Is `registrable_domain` an IP address, a free hosting or site-builder domain, a dynamic-DNS domain, or a URL shortener?

q_urgency.instructions: Does `visible_text` pressure the reader with urgency, threats, account suspension or a time limit?

q_reward_bait.instructions: Does `visible_text` promise a prize, refund, gift or exclusive offer in exchange for entering data?

q_obfuscated_scripts.instructions: Does any entry in `scripts` indicate obfuscation (`entropy` above 5, or `tokens` containing eval, atob, unescape or fromcharcode)?

q_external_favicon.instructions: Is `favicon_host` a different registrable domain than `registrable_domain`?

q_shell_page.instructions: Is the page essentially a single login or data-entry form with very little other content in `visible_text`?

q_missing_legitimacy.instructions: Does `visible_text` lack the elements a legitimate organisation's page normally has, such as contact information, a privacy policy, terms, or a copyright notice?

q_language_brand_mismatch.instructions: Is the language of `visible_text` implausible for the brand or organisation named on the page?

q_suspicious_url_shape.instructions: Does `page_url` have an unusual shape for a legitimate site: many hyphens, many subdomains, a very long path, encoded characters, or a misspelled brand?

q_cloned_assets.instructions: Are most hosts in `hosts.external_hosts` unrelated to `registrable_domain`, suggesting a cloned page loading its assets from the original site or a CDN?
